journey.name: System back
journey.description: The system back gesture: from Settings and from a tab it returns to Today; from the Timer it returns to the presets it sits over, then to Today; during a workout it pauses and asks before ending.

actions.action: Tap the "Settings" button
Verify that the Settings screen is shown with a "Sound cues" switch
Press the system back button
Verify that the Today tab is shown with "This week"
Tap the "History" tab
Press the system back button
Verify that the Today tab is shown with "This week"
Tap the "Train" tab, tap "Conditioning", then tap "Timer" at the top of the presets, and verify that the Timer is shown with a "Start workout" button
Press the system back button
Verify that Train is shown on "Conditioning", the presets under the "Timer" row, with the "Train" tab selected
Press the system back button
Verify that the Today tab is shown with "This week"
Tap the "Train" tab, tap "Timer" at the top of the presets, then tap "Start workout"
Press the system back button
Verify that a dialog titled "End workout?" is shown and the workout is paused
Tap "Resume" in the dialog
Verify that the workout screen shows a "Pause" button
Press the system back button
Tap "End workout" in the dialog
Verify that the Timer is shown with a "Start workout" button
